scenes.title: Past Life · The Borrowed Pen
scenes.summary: Before the final SAT section in her past life, Shen Man asks Lin Zhixia to lend her a pen. Lin hands one over without thinking. When Shen Man returns it, her fingertip pauses on the barrel for half a second.
scenes.text:
Before the final SAT section. Outside the testing hall.

Lin Zhixia murmurs essay material to herself. Shen Man walks up.

SHEN MAN: Zhixia, lend me a pen. Mine just ran dry.

Lin Zhixia pulls one from her pencil case and hands it over without a thought.

Shen Man takes it, scribbles twice on scratch paper, hands it back.

SHEN MAN: Thanks. This one writes nice.

Lin Zhixia doesn't care. She doesn't see it — when Shen Man returns the pen, her fingertip pauses on the barrel for half a second.

scenes.title: Past Life · Score Night
scenes.summary: On SAT score night in her past life, Lin Zhixia sees 1200. Her score verification is denied. Shen Man tops the school with 1590, a blue mark fading on her palm.
scenes.text:
Late night. Lin Zhixia logs in. The screen flashes: 1200.

She refreshes a dozen times. Her hands shake harder each time. Her mother leans in, looks once, and drops into a chair.

Her teacher, Old Chen, is stunned on the phone.

OLD CHEN (V.O.): Impossible. I've taught for twenty years... I'll file a score verification for you right now.

Three days later, the College Board denies it. The reply is four words: Score is correct.

Meanwhile, Shen Man tops the whole school with 1590. In an interview she says, "I just performed above my usual level." Then her eyes go blank for a second. She glances down at the hand that took the pen — a faint blue mark on her palm, fading.

The comments all praise her: "Rich and she still works this hard."

scenes.title: Past Life · The Rooftop
scenes.summary: On college decision day in her past life, Shen Man admits the score swap on the rooftop and pushes Lin Zhixia off, staging it as suicide.
scenes.text:
College decision day. An anonymous text lures her to the rooftop.

Shen Man drops all pretense.

SHEN MAN: You think I got here on my father? His three million bought off the College Board's verification. The swap — I did that myself.

LIN ZHIXIA: You?

Shen Man holds out her hand. The blue mark on her palm is almost invisible now.

SHEN MAN: That pen of yours. It writes nice. Guess why I had to borrow yours?

Lin Zhixia turns to leave — to report it, to call the police. Footsteps close behind her. Two hands slam into her back.

Over the rushing wind, Shen Man's voice drifts down from the rooftop edge.

SHEN MAN: Next life, don't lend your pen to just anyone.

What the world called a suicide was a murder, start to finish.

scenes.title: Rebirth · The Switch
scenes.summary: Lin Zhixia wakes on the first morning of the SAT. She writes three rules and places Zhou Yu's forgotten pen in the outer pocket of her pencil case.
scenes.text:
She opens her eyes. It's the first morning of the SAT.

The admission ticket on the desk. Her mother's porridge at the door. The date on her phone — identical to her memory.

Lin Zhixia pinches the back of her hand. It hurts.

She sits for ten minutes, then writes three lines in her notebook:

"One. She borrows a pen to swap scores. The pen is the anchor.
Two. Don't lend her mine.
Three. That push on the rooftop — this time she hits air. And I record it."

She closes the notebook and checks her pencil case: her own pen, a spare, and one Zhou Yu left on her desk last week.

She puts Zhou Yu's pen in the outer pocket.

scenes.title: Rebirth · The Testing Hall
scenes.summary: Before the final SAT section, Shen Man borrows a pen again. Lin Zhixia hands over Zhou Yu's pen. When Shen Man returns it, her fingertip pauses half a second.
scenes.text:
Before the final SAT section. Shen Man walks right up, just as expected.

SHEN MAN: Zhixia, lend me a pen. Mine ran dry.

Lin Zhixia smiles and pulls the pen from the outer pocket.

LIN ZHIXIA: Here.

Shen Man takes it, scribbles twice on scratch paper. Lin Zhixia notices her grip is strange — like she's feeling for something.

When she returns it, her fingertip pauses on the barrel for half a second. Exactly like last time.

Lin Zhixia takes it back, drops it in her pencil case, and never touches that pen again.

scenes.title: Replay · Score Night
scenes.summary: On score night after her rebirth, Lin Zhixia sees SAT 1590. Zhou Yu sees 1480. Shen Man scores only 1200 and posts about it in the class group.
scenes.text:
Score night. Lin Zhixia logs into her College Board account. The screen flashes: 1590 — exactly what she estimated.

She stares for a few seconds, refreshes. Still 1590.

Her phone rings. Zhou Yu's voice shakes.

ZHOU YU (V.O.): Zhixia, I got 1480. But I estimated around 1200!

Lin Zhixia grips the phone and slowly smiles. Halfway through, the smile stops.

Meanwhile, the class group explodes. Shen Man posts a screenshot of her score — 1200.

SHEN MAN (TEXT): 1200. How is this possible?

The comments go quiet for a long time. Then someone asks carefully: "Man, did they get it wrong?"

Shen Man doesn't reply.

scenes.title: Zhou Yu's Score
scenes.summary: After her score verification fails, Zhou Yu confronts Lin Zhixia. Shen Man bursts in and blurts out what she shouldn't know. Lin Zhixia admits she deliberately lent Zhou Yu's pen to Shen Man. Zhou Yu leaves in fury.
scenes.text:
The next day, Zhou Yu rushes into Lin Zhixia's home, eyes red.

ZHOU YU: I filed a score verification with the College Board. They say my 1480 is correct. But I estimated barely over 1200!

Before Lin Zhixia can speak, Shen Man pushes the door open. She grabs Zhou Yu's phone, sees 1480, and the words fly out.

SHEN MAN: You only had 1200!

ZHOU YU: Scores just came out. How do you know what I had before?

Shen Man's face changes. She slams down the phone and storms out.

Zhou Yu turns to Lin Zhixia.

ZHOU YU: Zhixia. Do you know something?

A long silence. Then Lin Zhixia speaks.

LIN ZHIXIA: That pen. The one she borrowed — it was yours.

Zhou Yu freezes.

ZHOU YU: What pen?

LIN ZHIXIA: On SAT day she borrowed a pen. I handed her yours.

Zhou Yu's face slowly changes.

ZHOU YU: You did it on purpose?

Lin Zhixia doesn't deny it.

ZHOU YU: So you protected yourself and pushed me out there instead?

LIN ZHIXIA: I didn't think it would go this way. I thought she was swapping —

ZHOU YU: You thought? That's my SAT score. What do you mean, you thought?

The door closes. Lin Zhixia sits in the dark and doesn't turn on the light for a long time.

scenes.title: The Rooftop · Closing the Net
scenes.summary: Lin Zhixia confronts Shen Man on the rooftop. She threatens her with the offline backup to force a confession. Shen Man lunges, hits the railing. Police, Zhou Yu, and Old Song arrive.
scenes.text:
That night, Shen Man calls. Her voice shakes.

SHEN MAN (V.O.): It was you. You switched my pen.

LIN ZHIXIA: I didn't switch anything. I just didn't lend you mine.

SHEN MAN (V.O.): Do you know how long I prepared?!

LIN ZHIXIA: Zhou Yu prepared longer.

Three seconds of silence on the line.

SHEN MAN (V.O.): You're dead.

The next night, eight p.m. The rooftop.

Lin Zhixia goes. An action camera is clipped to her backpack strap. A recorder hides in her sleeve. Zhou Yu waits in the stairwell — not to help her, but to hear Shen Man admit the swap with her own ears and take her score back.

Shen Man comes up holding a pen.

SHEN MAN: Do you know what this is? The moment I write your name —

LIN ZHIXIA: Write it.

She cuts her off.

LIN ZHIXIA: You swapped Zhou Yu once. Swap me again, and the log shows two entries. You can delete the server. You can't delete the offline backup. You have one choice: admit the swap and give Zhou Yu her score back.

Shen Man lunges. Lin Zhixia steps aside. Shen Man can't stop herself and slams into the railing.

Footsteps thunder up the stairwell — police, Zhou Yu, and Old Song, the technician the Shen family fired, holding printed system logs.

scenes.title: The Log
scenes.summary: Three days earlier, Lin Zhixia found Old Song. He shows her the Easy-Swap system log: borrower Shen Man, lender Zhou Yu, swap successful, then a note — wrong target, rollback advised. Zhou Yu learns the system marked her as "advised to ignore."
scenes.text:
Three days earlier, Lin Zhixia knocked on Old Song's door.

In her past life, during score week, a forum post from someone claiming to be inside the scoring system was deleted within seconds. She memorized the ID. This life, she followed the thread.

Old Song spreads printouts on the table: an unsigned anomaly module, code name "Easy-Swap." Only two fields.

"Borrower: Shen Man. Lender: Zhou Yu. Swap result: Success."

Three days later, a new line appears.

"Wrong target. Rollback advised."

LIN ZHIXIA: The system knows it swapped the wrong person.

OLD SONG: The system isn't stupid. It just doesn't care.

Zhou Yu stands in the doorway, voice barely audible.

ZHOU YU: So my score was marked "advised to ignore"?

Old Song says nothing. He slides the USB drive across the table.

scenes.title: The Trial
scenes.summary: Police open a case. Shen Man's lawyer argues the system doesn't exist. The prosecution submits three pieces of evidence. The judge asks Shen Man why, after seeing 1480, her first move was to call Lin Zhixia.
scenes.text:
Police open a case.

Shen Man's lawyer argues the so-called system doesn't exist at all.

The prosecution submits three things: Old Song's offline log, the rooftop recording, and a screenshot of Shen Man's post from the night she checked her SAT score.

In court, the judge looks at Shen Man.

JUDGE: You saw 1480. Your first reaction was to call Lin Zhixia — not to file a score verification with the College Board. Why?

Shen Man opens her mouth. Nothing comes out.

Lin Zhixia sits in the gallery and doesn't look at her.

scenes.title: Settling Accounts
scenes.summary: Officials announce Shen Man's arrest, her father's bribery investigation, and the collapse of Shen Group. The Easy-Swap system is handed to investigators. Zhou Yu's score is restored, but the friendship can't be.
scenes.text:
Official statement: Shen Man used an unidentified "Easy-Swap system" to illegally swap scoring data. She is charged with unauthorized modification of computer systems and attempted murder, and arrested. Her father is investigated for paying three million to buy off the verification process. The bribery chain is exposed. Shen Group's stock falls seven days straight, the bank calls its loans, and the company declares bankruptcy.

The Easy-Swap system's origin is unknown. It has been handed to a special agency for investigation.

Zhou Yu's score is restored to her raw paper score. The day her admission letter arrives, she sends Lin Zhixia a message.

ZHOU YU (TEXT): My score is back. But we can't go back.

Lin Zhixia stares at the screen for a long time. She replies with one word.

LIN ZHIXIA (TEXT): Yeah.

scenes.title: Epilogue
scenes.summary: Lin Zhixia receives her admission letter. She and Zhou Yu message each other about their majors. She keeps Zhou Yu's pen as a warning.
scenes.text:
The day Lin Zhixia's admission letter arrives, her mother wipes the envelope three times before daring to open it.

Her phone lights up. A message from Zhou Yu.

ZHOU YU (TEXT): I applied for education. I'll be a teacher. No one swaps a student's score on my watch.

Lin Zhixia smiles and types back.

LIN ZHIXIA (TEXT): I applied for law.

ZHOU YU (TEXT): Why?

LIN ZHIXIA (TEXT): Because the system is still out there. Someone has to watch it.

She places the pen — Zhou Yu's pen — under the glass on her desk. Beside it, a sticky note:

"This time, every point is mine. Next time, no one takes it."

But she doesn't throw the pen away. The system never disappeared. It just changed its shape, waiting for the next person who lends a pen.
